medical_document_text: HPI/history: 65-year-old male with intermediate-risk adenocarcinoma of the prostate (Gleason 3+4), presenting for definitive radiation therapy planning. Imaging/lab findings: The patient was placed on the CT simulator table in the supine position. A custom Vac-Lok immobilization device was fabricated for the lower extremities to ensure reproducible daily setup. A knee sponge and ankle sponge were utilized. The patient was aligned using the room lasers, and radiopaque fiducial markers were placed on the skin at the anterior and bilateral setup points. A non-contrast planning CT scan of the pelvis was acquired from the level of L4 through the mid-femora using 3 mm slice thickness. The acquired CT images demonstrate adequate visualization of the prostate gland, seminal vesicles, and surrounding critical structures including the rectum, bladder, bilateral femoral heads, and penile bulb. No acute incidental findings are noted on the non-contrast planning scan. Assessment/impression: Successful complex CT simulation and custom immobilization for prostate cancer radiation therapy planning. Plan/follow-up: The image dataset has been exported to the treatment planning system. Target volumes and organs at risk will be contoured, and an IMRT treatment plan will be generated.
